payload.message: Probe PR status per thread with gh and degrade silently when it is missing.

content.text:
### PR indicator

The probe caches per branch and never blocks a render. When `gh` is absent, unauthenticated, or the branch has no PR, the column renders nothing rather than an error.

| state | glyph |
| --- | --- |
| open | ● |
| draft | ○ |
